assessment: Following up the previous observation that UHRF1-mediated dual mono-ubiquitylation of PAF15 (PAF15Ub2) promotes PAF15 chromatin loading and DNMT1 recruitment to the DNA replication sites, this study provides convincing evidence showing that termination of PAF15Ub2 signaling is regulated by USP7-mediated deubiquitylation and ATAD5-mediated removal from chromatin. These are important findings for our understanding of how the maintenance DNA methylation machinery is disassembled post replication.
